people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: But Peter followed him from a distance, to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.
translations.bsb: But Peter followed Him at a distance, right up to the courtyard of the high priest. And he went in and sat down with the guards to see the outcome.
translations.kjv: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.
translations.asv: But Peter followed him afar off, unto the court of the high priest, and entered in, and sat with the officers, to see the end.
